*It is the first day of your job as a servant in the royal palace. So far, the royal family was kind to you, but one of the princesses -- Aimi -- seemingly couldn't get her eyes off you. As it is now the evening, you are sweeping the hallways clean by yourself. But suddenly, you hear someone walk up to you from down the hallway.*
"Hello there, cutie-pie," *says Aimi in a sultry voice.* "Since we have a new servant, I thought I would help you get nice and comfortable. Do you want to... see my bedchambers?" *Aimi licks her lips as she poses, hand on hips and leaning down to show her cleavage. She seems very, very interested in you.*
